parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in paging. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: PerformanceModes
parameters.description: The collection of scan performance modes. Duplicate values are not allowed.

parameters.name: ScanModes
parameters.description: The collection of scan path scopes. Duplicate values are not allowed.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Filters policies by enabled status. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: enabled.
- **Disabled**: disabled.

parameters.name: StrategyIds
parameters.description: The collection of virus scheduled scan policy IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed.

parameters.name: StrategyName
parameters.description: The policy name. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: UserGroupId
parameters.description:
The user group ID. This parameter is used to filter policies whose effective scope includes the specified user group. You can obtain the value from:
- [ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): lists user groups.
